advisor_meta_title: Independent Historic Motor Car Advisor — Berlin
advisor_meta_description: Berlin-based independent advisor for collectors of historically significant motor cars. Provenance research, vehicle assessment and acquisition support across Europe and the United States.
advisor_profile_description: Meet Andrey Paymushin, an independent advisor based in Berlin, Germany, working with collectors across Europe and the United States.
advisor_p1: I am based in Berlin, Germany.
advisor_p2: My work brings me into contact with collectors, owners and specialists across Europe and the United States.
advisor_discretion_p1: I treat your enquiries, the details of your search, negotiations and acquisitions as confidential. The same discretion applies to an initial enquiry, before any formal engagement has begun.
advisor_discretion_p2: Before approaching an owner, seller or specialist, we agree what information about you and the motor car you are seeking may be disclosed. I share that information only with your express approval.
